fichas.summary: Guidance for school circulation and emergency escape routes specifies minimum widths, route lengths, door-opening behavior, stair geometry, and ramp gradient. Horizontal and vertical access routes normally also serve as emergency escape routes.

fichas.title: School break and communal areas
fichas.summary: Enclosed break areas are sized by a per-pupil space guideline and should support school events. Dining and multi-purpose rooms, or a roofed connection to a sports hall, may also serve as break areas. Larger schools should provide a communal area for events and celebrations, potentially by temporarily connecting rooms and circulation areas.
